reference_sql:
WITH lowest_prices AS (
  SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS lowest_competitor_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, lp.lowest_competitor_eur
FROM sales s
JOIN lowest_prices lp ON lp.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.parent_category = 'Audio'
GROUP BY s.product_id, lp.lowest_competitor_eur

solver.query:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  GROUP BY product_id
), lowest AS (
  SELECT product_id, MIN(price_eur) AS lowest_competitor_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, s.units, l.lowest_competitor_eur
FROM sold s
JOIN lowest l ON l.product_id = s.product_id
